lines.t: Cut ties, no lie, blade sharp on the spine of the timeline, yeah I sever that vein.
Whole clique full of snakes in the grass, bare feet on the path, I can feel every hiss in the grain.
They smile but they whisper my name, call it “cult,” call it “phase,” call it anything to keep me in a cage.
But the flame in my bones too heavy for the shade, when the Lion starts to roar every wall gotta fade.
She said, “I won’t cut nobody off,” that’s a choice not a flaw, that’s a line in the dust, that’s a side in the war.
I ain’t bending what I bleed for, die for, ride for, Word like a two‑edged sword in my core.
Girlfriend, baby mama, put a ring on her finger, still she chose with the scoffers at the door.
So I step back, spine straight, heart sore, peace in my face, feet clean from the floor.
I don’t break, I divide, line drawn in the sky, pick a side, this a war not a vibe.
If you ride with the haters and the mockers of the Voice, understand you already chose your side.
I stand with YahuShua, hands up high, no cap, every chain on my flesh get fried.
If you war with His Word, you war with my King, that means you can’t walk by my side.
Whole fam throwing shade from the porch, they offended by the torch that I carry in the night.
They’d rather keep peace with the dark than be scorched by the ark when it crashes through the pride.
They say, “Blood that’s thicker than the water,” but I’m bathed in a river that was red for my life.

If the cross drew a line through the middle of my house then I follow that line with the knife.I ain’t moving out of fear, I’m just moving out of trust, when He says, “Step,” I don’t argue with the dust.
Every rebel in my circle wanna cuddle with the rust, they can have their applause, I’ma stay with the Just.
They mock every letter, every trumpet, every call, but the ink already branded in my chest.
You can laugh at the message, but the storm still falls, and the Rock still stands when it hits every crest.
I don’t break, I divide, line drawn in the sky, pick a side, this a war not a vibe.
If you ride with the haters and the mockers of the Voice, understand you already chose your side.
I stand with YahuShua, hands up high, no cap, every chain on my flesh get fried.
If you war with His Word, you war with my King, that means you can’t walk by my side.
She say I’m “just a guy,” I’m “a friend,” I’m “a stranger with a pen,” but she knows who be speaking through the fire.
She’d rather calm mama’s nerves, keep the cousins undisturbed, than respect what was breathed from the Choir.
They can eat with the scoff, trade memes, throw talk, dress doubt up nice in a gown.
I’m a watchman on the wall with a sword and a jaw that was forged to resound, not drown.If you fight on His name, you ain’t cuddling with me, I’m not sharing one pillow with that smoke.
You can kiss me goodnight with a tear on your screen, but the bond already broke when you joked.
‘Cause if you touch what He sent, you just touched my blood, and I’m loyal to the Throne over flesh.
I’ll still pray for your soul, I’ll still beg for your breath, but I won’t let your rebellion in my nest.
No hate in my veins, no venom in my speech, just a firewall lit by the King.
I cut off hands that keep dragging to the pit, but I still keep the names when I sing.
On my knees for the enemies, tears for the frenemies, family or not, they can’t share this ring.
If you curse what He’s speaking, for a season you’re exed, you ain’t worthy of the Bride or the bling.
I don’t break, I divide, line drawn in the sky, pick a side, this a war not a vibe.
If you ride with the haters and the mockers of the Voice, understand you already chose your side.
I stand with YahuShua, hands up high, no cap, every chain on my flesh get fried.
If you war with His Word, you war with my King, that means you can’t walk by my side.
So I walk out the house with the Book on my tongue, while the scoffers all scroll, throw stones from their phones.
Every rebel I release from my couch, from my bed, from my table, from my throne.
I ain’t casting you to hell, I’m just handing you to Him, I’m removing your grip from my dome.
I chose King over kin, over wife, over friends, ‘cause the Lamb is my blood, that’s home.
